subject.title: feat(control-ui): show compaction savings and run time

question: Should the Control UI permanently expose both compaction token savings and live run elapsed time in the main chat transcript?
rationale: The linked issue and PR add persistent user-facing product UI and carry protected maintainer/product-decision signals; implementation evidence can establish quality but cannot authorize the product direction.

options.title: Sponsor both indicators
options.body: Accept both observability features after the elapsed-start defect is fixed and the refreshed head passes required checks.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Choose only compaction savings or elapsed time and ask the branch to remove the unsponsored portion before merge.

options.title: Defer the UI change
options.body: Keep the existing checkpoint drawer and working indicator unchanged and close the candidate until the direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Sponsor both indicators
recommendation.body: Accept both observability features after the elapsed-start defect is fixed and the refreshed head passes required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged history across the Control UI chat lifecycle and gateway/WebChat behavior involved in the decision.
